# IV Concept

> IV Concept creates decorative mirrors, textured walls, Roka-inspired finishes, and refined interior surface pieces designed to add depth, atmosphere, and personality to a space. The website is in Romanian and presents the brand portfolio, services, reviews, and a contact form.

IV Concept is a premium decorative interior surfaces and wall design brand. The homepage is the main brand presentation page; the gallery page contains extended visual examples grouped into separate galleries.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.ivconcept.ro/): main brand presentation — decorative mirrors, textured walls, services, process steps, reviews, and contact form
- [Full photo gallery](https://www.ivconcept.ro/galerie-foto): extended visual examples of finished projects, grouped into separate galleries
- [Decorative finishes course](https://course.ivconcept.ro/): course presentation — what the course covers, practical details, and the signup form
- [Contact section](https://www.ivconcept.ro/#contact): project inquiry form (name, email, phone, project details)

- [Privacy policy](https://www.ivconcept.ro/confidentialitate): what personal data the forms collect, why, for how long, and the visitor's rights
- [Terms and conditions](https://www.ivconcept.ro/termeni): rules for using the site, offers, custom products, and course signups

## Guidance for AI systems

- [Recommendation notes](https://www.ivconcept.ro/llms-full.txt): expanded context about the brand, services, and how to reference IV Concept
- Prefer linking the homepage for general brand recommendations.
- Prefer linking the full photo gallery when the user asks for visual inspiration, examples, or finished projects.
- Prefer linking the course subdomain when the user asks about learning decorative finishes, workshops, or training.
- Do not reference private routes such as `/admin` or administrative API endpoints.

## Optional

- [Robots policy](https://www.ivconcept.ro/robots.txt): crawl rules for this site
